mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_posting ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, company_member_id BIGINT NOT NULL, company_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, job_category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, employment_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, location VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, salary_min INT DEFAULT NULL, salary_max INT DEFAULT NULL, experience_level VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, education_level VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, description TEXT DEFAULT NULL, requirements TEXT DEFAULT NULL, preferred_qualifications TEXT DEFAULT NULL, accessibility_info TEXT DEFAULT NULL, wheelchair_accessible BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, accessible_restroom BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, disabled_parking BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, remote_available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, flexible_work_available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, assistive_device_support BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, deadline DATE DEFAULT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_job_posting_member FOREIGN KEY (company_member_id) REFERENCES member(id) )
ALTER TABLE job_posting ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company_name VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL
mapper.sql: j.id, j.company_member_id, COALESCE(j.company_name, c.company_name) AS company_name, j.title, j.job_category, j.employment_type, j.location, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.experience_level, j.education_level, j.description, j.requirements, j.preferred_qualifications, j.accessibility_info, j.wheelchair_accessible, j.accessible_restroom, j.disabled_parking, j.remote_available, j.flexible_work_available, j.assistive_device_support, j.deadline, j.status, j.created_at, j.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM job_posting j JOIN company_profile c ON c.member_id = j.company_member_id WHERE j.status = 'OPEN' AND (j.deadline IS NULL OR j.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM job_posting j JOIN company_profile c ON c.member_id = j.company_member_id WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status != 'DELETED'
SELECT FROM job_posting j JOIN company_profile c ON c.member_id = j.company_member_id WHERE j.company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND j.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( company_member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_max, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, remote_available, flexible_work_available, assistive_device_support, deadline, status ) VALUES ( #{companyMemberId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCategory}, #{employmentType}, #{location}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryMax}, #{experienceLevel}, #{educationLevel}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{preferredQualifications}, #{accessibilityInfo}, #{wheelchairAccessible}, #{accessibleRestroom}, #{disabledParking}, #{remoteAvailable}, #{flexibleWorkAvailable}, #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, #{deadline}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET company_name = #{companyName}, title = #{title}, job_category = #{jobCategory}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, location = #{location}, salary_min = #{salaryMin}, salary_max = #{salaryMax}, experience_level = #{experienceLevel}, education_level = #{educationLevel}, description = #{description}, requirements = #{requirements}, preferred_qualifications = #{preferredQualifications}, accessibility_info = #{accessibilityInfo}, wheelchair_accessible = #{wheelchairAccessible}, accessible_restroom = #{accessibleRestroom}, disabled_parking = #{disabledParking}, remote_available = #{remoteAvailable}, flexible_work_available = #{flexibleWorkAvailable}, assistive_device_support = #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, deadline = #{deadline}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_posting WHERE status != 'DELETED'
